|Notes=
* Normal hits are frontal AoE and take multiple shadow images.
** Will continue to attack normally like an Ironclad even if the current hate target is not in range.
** Occasionally jumps and lands for high radial AoE damage in place of a normal attack round.
* Gains increased evasion and defense at lower HP.
* Uses the following TP moves:
** '''Slicing Sickle''': Frontal AoE heavy physical damage, knockback, and defense down
** '''Macerating Bile''': AoE heavy DoT Bio and all stats down
** '''Raptorial Claw''': Frontal AoE physical damage, knockback, and magic defense down
** '''Preying Posture''': Attack Boost, Accuracy Boost, Magic Attack Boost, and Intension for Kaggen and highly potent Defense Down and [[Gravity]] aura.
*** Each of the buffs are dispellable, but it will take four dispels to remove them all.
** '''Phlegm Expulsion''': AoE Slow, Silence, Amnesia
** '''Death Prophet''': Only used <50% HP, frontal AoE Death (stunnable)
*** Death Prophet is always preceded by Preying Posture.
****Note: Even if Kaggen is stunned or staggered after Preying Posture, it may still attempt Death Prophet once the stun or stagger wears off.
* Casts various AoE enfeebles ([[Poisonga II]], [[Graviga]], [[Paralyga]], [[Sleepga]]) and wind elemental nukes ([[Aero V]], [[Aeroga IV]], [[Aeroja]])
* Kaggen has 99 INT, 96 MND, 105 CHR, and 50 [[Magic Defense Bonus]]
[http://www.bluegartr.com/threads/104509-Voidwatch-Discussion?p=4847877&viewfull=1#post4847877 1]
